comparison.objective: Thread and hand-tighten a spin-on oil filter to a prescribed post-contact angle.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial threaded rotation and wrist-driven regrasping; no support-interface transfer or loose-element containment.
comparison.success_condition: Filter ends 240–360° past gasket contact, never exceeds damage limits, and is released stably.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled threaded tightening and gasket compression, not flush rail–jig mating while sliding an uncaged bearing block and retaining free balls. Candidate numeric force, gap, and angular tolerances remain unspecified, but the objectives are clearly different.
